headerSection.carvingDifficulty: Carving Difficulty (0 Easy, 1 Low Rank, 2 High Rank, 3 Treasure Hunt, 4 Training)
headerSection.arrivalPosition: Arrival Position (00 Camp, 01 Random, 02 Special (Watch Cutscene))

supplyState.supplyConditions: Rationing Conditions (When supply state is 2, fill with monster code)
supplyState.conditionQuantity: Condition Quantity (When supply state is 2, fill with monster quantity)

smallMonsterChange0.changeCondition: Change Condition (0 None, 1 On Kill, 2 On Gather)
smallMonsterChange0.sequenceNumber: Sequence Number (0 Initial Small Monsters, 1 Small Monster Change 1, 2 Small Monster Change 2)

smallMonsterChange1.changeCondition: Change Condition (0 None, 1 On Kill, 2 On Gather)
smallMonsterChange1.sequenceNumber: Sequence Number (0 Initial Small Monsters, 1 Small Monster Change 1, 2 Small Monster Change 2)

questInformation.questType: Quest Type (1 Slay, 2 Gather, 4 Hunt, 8 Special, 10 Treasure Hunt, 81 Slay [Elder Dragon], 88 Special [Elder Dragon])
questInformation.additional: Additional attributes of the quest type
questInformation.questTime: Quest Time (Divide by 1800 to get minutes)
questInformation.unknown1: Unknown (1 byte skip after star level)
questInformation.targetCount: Target Count (Fill 1 for Target 0, 2 for Target 1, other values prevent quest completion)
questInformation.unknown2: Unknown (1 byte skip after target count)

questTarget0.questCondition: Quest Condition (1 Slay, 2 Deliver, 4 Slay [Elder Dragon])
questTarget0.additionalCondition: Additional Condition (When quest condition is 4, 0x0180 indicates inherited HP)

questTarget1.questCondition: Quest Condition (1 Slay, 2 Deliver, 4 Slay [Elder Dragon])
questTarget1.additionalCondition: Additional Condition (When quest condition is 4, 0x0180 indicates inherited HP)

questInformation.trainingDataPtr: [Pointer] Training Data (Equipment restrictions for training challenges)

textCommissionContent.questName: Quest Name (Ends with 00 and is 4-byte aligned)
textCommissionContent.successDesc: Success Description (Ends with 00 and is 4-byte aligned)
textCommissionContent.failureDesc: Failure Description (Ends with 00 and is 4-byte aligned)
textCommissionContent.questDesc: Quest Description (Ends with 00 and is 4-byte aligned)
textCommissionContent.mainMonster: Main Monster (Ends with 00 and is 4-byte aligned)

fixedInformation.initialInfoState: Initial Information State? (All quests seem to use 1B)
fixedInformation.unknown2: Unknown block (88 bytes padding, variable content)

_item.code: Code (Must match one of the small monster spawn codes, otherwise invalid)
_item.state: State? (Affects at least Herbivores and Stones)
_item.quantity: Quantity (Number spawned at this position, can be up to 65535)
_item.unknown0: Unknown (20 bytes, sometimes has 0x01 and rest 0's, or just full 0s)

unknownPostinitSmallMon: Post initial small monster unknown block (12 bytes, not fixed values)

_item.code: Code (Must match one of the boss spawn codes, otherwise invalid)
_item.quantity: Quantity (Number spawned at this position, can be set to 127)
_item.spawnArea: Exit Area (Area where the boss spawns at the start)
